parsed.rationale: All four participating records reside under `Tests/` directories — specifically `Shared/Playback/Tests/RadioPlayerTests/RadioPlayerControllerTests.swift`, `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/MockAudioSession.swift` (two declarations), and `Shared/PartyHorn/Tests/PartyHornTests/SoundPlayerTests.swift`. Although the pipeline emitted `is_test: false` and `is_mock: false` for every record, the file paths are unambiguous: all four are test-target fixtures, and two live in an explicit `Mocks/` subdirectory. Consolidating these into shared production code would couple production targets to test/mock semantics. The name collision across `Playback` and `PartyHorn` packages is expected and intentional: each package owns its own mock of `AudioSession` for isolated unit testing.
